question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: The practitioner should meditate on that object in every place as pervading from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in every place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
